title: Core Model Architectures
summary: Defines the core model architectures for various tasks, including causal language modeling, sequence classification, object detection, and multimodal processing.

nodes.label: Causal Language Models
nodes.title: Causal Language Models
nodes.description: Contains various causal language models, including those with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, for text generation tasks.

nodes.label: Text Classification & QA
nodes.title: Text Classification & Question Answering
nodes.description: Includes models for sequence classification, token classification, and question answering tasks.

nodes.label: Masked Language Models
nodes.title: Masked Language Models
nodes.description: Houses models designed for masked language modeling tasks.

nodes.label: Object Detection
nodes.title: Object Detection Models
nodes.description: Provides models for detecting objects in images, including DETR-based and document-layout specific architectures.

nodes.label: Segmentation Models
nodes.title: Segmentation Models
nodes.description: Contains models for universal image segmentation (panoptic, instance, semantic) and video object segmentation.

nodes.label: Speech & Audio Models
nodes.title: Speech and Audio Processing Models
nodes.description: Comprises models for X-Vector extraction, Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC), audio frame classification, and audio pre-training.

nodes.label: Multimodal Generation
nodes.title: Multimodal Conditional Generation Models
nodes.description: Offers models for conditional generation tasks involving multiple modalities like text-to-text, speech-to-speech, text-to-speech, vision-to-text, and protein-to-text.

nodes.label: General Multimodal Models
nodes.title: General Multimodal Models
nodes.description: Includes core multimodal architectures for tasks such as image-text understanding, contrastive learning, and cross-modal retrieval.

nodes.label: Prediction Models
nodes.title: Prediction Models
nodes.description: Features models for time series forecasting and protein folding prediction.

groups.label: Language Models
groups.title: Language-Centric Models
groups.description: Models primarily focused on text understanding, generation, and classification.

groups.label: Vision Models
groups.title: Vision-Centric Models
groups.description: Models specialized in processing and analyzing visual data for detection and segmentation tasks.

groups.label: Integrated & Specialized
groups.title: Integrated and Specialized Models
groups.description: Models combining multiple modalities or designed for highly specific predictive and analytical tasks.
